chapter: Earl Hines, Chicago and later gigs
title: Chicago theaters and Earl Hines going out to play
summary: The Oriental Theater show with Milton Berle, and Hines taking men out to play all night.

story.theme_name: Medicine shows, minstrels, circuses and the black theater circuit
story.community_name: On the road with minstrel, carnival and tent shows

blocks.x: And Chicago was alive in those days. I remember we played a show at the Oriental Theater with Earl Hines, and that show was Milton Berle. But nobody knew much about him then. You know, he was very young then. And his mother used to come around all the shows where he was then. But he was on the show. This was when all the theaters used to have shows. The Oriental Theater and all the other theaters.

Earl used to like to go out and play a lot. Earl would. It was fun when we played with Earl because he'd say let's go out and play -- a few of us -- this place or that place. And we'd go out after we got through work and play all night.
